messages:
ana: Heads up - us-central2 ephemeral nvme iops spike hits ~180k for 15m, GPU attach latencies climbing. infra-bot triggered.
infra-bot: [ALERT] ephemeral_nvme_iops > 150000 (us-central2) - sustained 15m. dashboard: /dash/ephemeral-iops. runbook: /runbooks/ephemeral-attach.md
rob: seeing a read-heavy pattern from image pulls and scrub overlapping with scheduled batch reclaims. scheduler pending pods ~85.
chi: we rolled the cleaner increase yesterday to catch up backlog, suspect scrub concurrency is the driver.
alisha: scrub_concurrency in us-central2 is 12 now (from rollout). dropping to 5 helped before. we should throttle.
nana: typo - ana meant 'ana' will apply hotfix. ana: applying hotfix to reduce concurrency and disable aggressive trim.
ops-runner: proposed commands:
```
kubectl set env deployment/cleaner CLEANER_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=5 -n infra-us-central2
kubectl set env deployment/cleaner ENABLE_AGGRESSIVE_TRIM=false -n infra-us-central2
kubectl scale deployment/cleaner --replicas=1 -n infra-us-central2
```
rob: patching now. monitoring iops.
[rob adds :eyes: reaction]
chi: also flip on local-image-cache for hot images to reduce read amplification; will push config.
nana: quick impact update: iops down 180k -> 62k within 6m, attach queue from 85 -> 9.
nana: good recovery. keeping throttles for 45m.
alisha: recommend a spill route if rates don't stabilize: route 10% of new gpu allocations to us-west1 for up to 3h. ops-costs estimated ~+$90/hr.
nana: filed routing change: `router-cli set-route --policy spill-us-central2-to-us-west1 --pct 10 --ttl 3h`
infra-bot: [ACTION] Route applied by ana (spill-us-central2-to-us-west1, 10%, 3h).
rob: monitoring shows attach latencies back to normal.
chi: follow-ups: RFC for adaptive-scrub, ops playbook update, and heater cache capacity increase.
nana: scheduling retro tomorrow 11:00am. thanks team. :thumbsup:
